description: Opaque ivory and pale gold floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, structured fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Rich gold floral and geometric embroidery covers the bodice and sleeves; long decorated vertical borders run along the skirt front and hem. A belt of round gold ornamental plaques encircles the waist. A large golden draped wrap lies over the forearms, falls at both sides and pools slightly on the ground; broad dark gold geometric borders edge it. A pendant necklace, dangling earrings and a bracelet accompany the gown. A patterned closed shoe shows at the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
